title: Drain cleaning in Riverton, OR | Bluewater Plumbing
metaDescription: Drain and sewer line cleaning for Riverton homes, with camera inspection and a clear price before the machine comes off the truck.
body:
Drain cleaning in Riverton, Oregon
Slow kitchen drains and backed-up floor drains are the two calls we get most in Riverton. Older houses near the river often have clay sewer laterals where roots get in at the joints.
We start with a camera when the line keeps clogging, so you can see the roots or the sag yourself. Then we quote the fix in writing before any digging.
A standard main-line cabling visit has one flat price. If the line needs hydro jetting instead, we say so and price it before we start.

faq.q: Do you camera the line first?
faq.a: When a line clogs more than once a year, yes. One-off kitchen sink clogs usually get cabled without a camera visit.

faq.q: What does a main-line clog cost?
faq.a: Cabling a main line from an accessible cleanout has one flat price, quoted on the phone. Root cutting or jetting is quoted after the camera look.
